name: cold-cache-guard
description: Asks what to do before Claude Code re-sends a large conversation whose prompt cache has expired: on a cold resume, and on the first prompt after an idle spell.

ttlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long an idle conversation stays cached: 60 on a Claude subscription, 5 on an API key, a cloud provider or usage credits unless promptCacheTtl says otherwise. Resumes use Claude Code's own estimate instead.

minTokens.title: Smallest context to ask about
minTokens.description: Conversations below this many tokens are re-sent without asking.
